source.title: NBA Official Rulebook
source.copyrightNote: Only titles and implementation classifications are recorded; protected rule prose is not redistributed.

entries.title: Court Dimensions - Equipment
entries.rationale: ABL models a fixed-point two-dimensional court, baskets, boundary, ball, and clocks rather than physical equipment; ball-handler boundary exits are derived from attempted movement.

entries.title: Duties of the Officials
entries.rationale: Three fallible referee agents and two bounded replay agents perform separated structured duties; assigned identities, evidence context, cognition receipts, and EIP-712 calls are verified before resolution.

entries.title: Players, Substitutes and Coaches
entries.rationale: ABL enforces active-five lineups, legal rosters, substitutions, coaches, ejections, and participation eligibility.

entries.title: Definitions
entries.rationale: Basketball terms are mapped to deterministic simulation concepts and versioned schemas.

entries.title: Scoring and Timing
entries.rationale: ABL uses four 12-minute quarters, scoring, game clock, overtime, and deterministic clock transitions.

entries.title: Putting Ball in Play - Live/Dead Ball
entries.rationale: The game state machine explicitly records held balls, jump-ball winners, awarded throw-ins, live/dead transitions, possession, and clocks.

entries.title: Shot Clock
entries.rationale: A deterministic 24-second clock, resets, violations, and review evidence are recorded in events.

entries.title: Out-of-Bounds and Throw-In
entries.rationale: Ball-handler boundary exits are derived from fixed-point movement; signed official last-touch calls award an explicit team-bound throw-in restart.

entries.title: Free Throws and Penalties
entries.rationale: Foul penalties, team-foul bonus thresholds, explicit free-throw lane activity, attempts, possession restarts, and deterministic shot resolution are modeled.

entries.title: Violations and Penalties
entries.rationale: The engine derives clock and ball-handler boundary violations. Other enumerated violations are versioned signed officiating decisions applied deterministically; it does not claim continuous-physics derivation for every violation subtype.

entries.title: Basket Interference - Goaltending
entries.rationale: Goaltending is a reviewable signed officiating fact whose points, possession, challenge, and reversal effects are deterministic. Season Zero does not claim a continuous ball-trajectory physics model.

entries.title: Fouls and Penalties
entries.rationale: Signed contact/conduct calls drive personal and per-period team fouls, bonus free throws, technicals, flagrants, ejections, and deterministic penalties.

entries.title: Instant Replay
entries.rationale: Two replay agents receive enhanced committed evidence and may reverse only a versioned reviewable class.

entries.title: Coach's Challenge
entries.rationale: The command state machine enforces available challenges, latest-event targeting, reviewable classes, and exact replay correction; coach identities use signed decision authority at the competition boundary.

entries.title: Comments on the Rules
entries.citation: NBA Official Rulebook, Comments on the Rules
entries.rationale: Interpretive concepts are encoded as cited versioned tests and ratifiable rule guidance, not copied prose.
